title: Universal alternating successor step
statement: Let $V$ be a language of binary strings, and let $m,k\in\mathbb{N}$ and $w$ be a binary string. In the alternating quantifier construction, the predicate at $k+1$ rounds with initial universal quantification holds for $w$ exactly when, for every binary string $u$ of length $m$, the predicate at $k$ rounds with initial existential quantification holds on the pair encoding of $w$ and $u$.
